sources.title: Joint distribution of two Local Times for diffusion processes with the application to the construction of various conditioned processes
sources.snippet: For a diffusion process $X(t)$ of drift $μ(x)$ and of diffusion coefficient $D=1/2$, we study the joint distribution of the two local times $A(t)= \int_{0}^{t} dτδ(X(τ)) $ and $B(t)= \int_{0}^{t} dτδ(X(τ)-L) $ at positions $x=0$ and $x=L$, as well as the simpler statistics of their sum $ Σ(t)=A(t)+B(t)$.
